message: Here are 6 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Track loader operating near workers
hazards.description: A compact track loader in the center-right of the site is working within a few meters of several workers on foot.

hazards.title: Workers near concrete truck chutes
hazards.description: Workers stand directly in front of and between two concrete mixer trucks in the center-left, handling the extended discharge chutes, exposing them to being struck if a truck moves or a chute swings.

hazards.title: Protruding conduit stubs and stakes
hazards.description: Numerous vertical conduit stubs, pipes and stakes protrude from the ground throughout the work area where workers walk, creating trip and impact hazards.

hazards.title: Worker bending while drilling
hazards.description: A worker on the left is bent over at the waist operating a power drill at ground level, an awkward posture.

hazards.title: Collapsed and sagging safety fencing
hazards.description: Orange barrier fencing in the foreground and left side is sagging and partly lying on the ground, making it an inadequate barricade and a tangle hazard.

hazards.title: Uneven ground and gravel piles
hazards.description: The site surface is rough with loose gravel and soil piles around the work area, creating uneven footing.
